content:
Nina: quick heads-up — vendor pushed APAC baremetal handoff to Mon AM, flagged mandatory firmware flash before we can onboard. this overlaps with the Friday e2e demo window.
Sam: do they require onsite techs or can we do remote via IPMI/jumpbox?
Nina: vendor prefers onsite but will accept remote if we provide a signed access window + reachable bastion + kube creds. they want a 90m window.
Devin: how many GPUs affected? we need exact numbers to decide borrow vs shrink.
Nina: ~9 A100s from apac-demo pool. demo planned 6 concurrent workers.
Liu: EU-standby can lend 3 (they're mid-tune), US-west has 4 spare but needs a short quota bump to 12 for our session.
Devin: 3 from EU isn't enough. Options: 1) shrink workers 6->4, 2) request +4 in us-west for the slot, 3) reschedule.
Nina: i'm filing a fast reservation: infra-bot please create +4 GPUs in us-west for 2026-04-02T02:00Z-05:00Z.
infra-bot: Reservation created RES-20901 | region=us-west | gpus=+4 | window=2026-04-02T02:00Z-05:00Z | priority=high. Approvers: @finance @allocs. ETA ~2h.
Sam: fallback if approval stalls: enable prefix cache warmup and reduce batch_size 8->4 to keep p95 under SLO.
Devin: can someone paste a minimal TF snippet to up pool quickly? i'll prep a PR and link the vault creds.
Liu: use this quick patch: ```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "temp_burst" {
  region    = "us-west1"
  gpu_count = 4
  labels    = { purpose = "temp-demo-burst" }
}
```
Devin: thanks — i'll open PR with var override once RES-20901 approves.
Nina: vendor ops requested a signed access window email to ops@vendor with contact + SSO bastion details. can someone draft and get security sign-off?
Sam: i'll draft template and post in 15m. tag me for sign-off, Devin.
VendorOps: we can accept remote flash if bastion reachable and signed window provided. onsite still fallback.
infra-bot: RES-20901 status=awaiting_approval. Approvers notified.
Liu: QA note: if we move region, set DNS TTL to 30s 10m before cutover and prepare cert reissue.
Nina: adding infra backlog item vendor-firmware-visibility after this thread. please file if you can.
Devin: filing INFRA-3245 now and linking here.
Sam: standing by to PR/merge once approval lands. drop :rotating_light: if you need immediate escalation.
